Best Exterior Paint Brands - Sherwin-Williams vs Benjamin Moore vs PPG is a question we hear regularly from homeowners across Hinsdale, Bolingbrook, and the broader western Chicago suburbs. After 15 years and hundreds of projects, D&D Pro Painting has developed clear answers backed by hands-on experience rather than theory.

## Understanding the Scope

Exterior painting in the Chicago suburbs involves more than applying color to walls. Illinois weather - temperature swings exceeding 100 degrees annually, 80-100 freeze-thaw cycles, persistent moisture from spring through fall - puts extraordinary stress on every painted surface. Any approach to exterior painting must account for these conditions or the results will disappoint within a few seasons.

Homeowners in Downers Grove and Glen Ellyn frequently ask us to repaint homes where a previous contractor skipped critical preparation steps. The pattern is consistent: paint that looked fine at completion begins failing within 18-24 months because the foundation underneath was not properly addressed.

## What to Expect from the Process

Understanding the process eliminates surprises and helps you plan around the disruption any painting project creates. Whether you are scheduling exterior painting or a different scope, the sequence follows a predictable pattern: consultation, color selection, preparation, application, and final walkthrough.

In Hinsdale and surrounding communities, D&D Pro Painting typically provides a written estimate within 48 hours of an on-site visit. Color consultation follows, then scheduling based on weather (exterior) or your household schedule (interior). Execution timelines depend on scope - single rooms take 1-2 days, whole-home projects take 10-30 working days.

## Local Considerations for Chicago Suburb Homeowners

Painting in the western Chicago suburbs carries specific considerations that generic online advice often misses.

**Illinois climate impact.** Temperature extremes from -15 to 100+ degrees Fahrenheit mean paint must flex without cracking through the full annual range. Products formulated for milder climates underperform here.

**HOA requirements.** Many Hinsdale and Bolingbrook subdivisions require color approval before painting begins. Painting without approval can trigger fines and forced repainting - an expensive mistake. Our team navigates HOA submissions routinely and maintains current palette documentation for active subdivisions.

**Seasonal timing.** Exterior painting season runs April through October in most years. Interior painting works year-round, with winter offering lower humidity and faster dry times. Spring and fall are peak demand seasons - book 4-6 weeks ahead for these windows.

**Local building codes.** Homes built before 1978 may contain lead paint that requires EPA RRP-certified contractors for any disturbance. D&D Pro Painting maintains current RRP certification and follows all required containment and documentation protocols.

faqs.question: What is the best time of year for exterior painting in Illinois?
faqs.answer: Late April through mid-October, when overnight temperatures consistently stay above 50 degrees Fahrenheit. May through September provides the most reliable conditions. Avoid painting in direct midday sun above 90 degrees - professional crews work early mornings and shaded elevations during peak summer heat.

faqs.question: How much does exterior painting cost in the Chicago suburbs?
faqs.answer: Typical two-story homes run $6,000-$10,000 for professional work with premium paint and thorough preparation. Smaller homes start around $3,500. Estate homes in Hinsdale and Oak Brook can run $15,000-$35,000+. The biggest cost driver is preparation intensity, which directly determines how long the paint job lasts.

faqs.question: How long does professional exterior painting take?
faqs.answer: Most single-family homes take 5-10 working days including preparation, priming, and two finish coats. Larger homes and estate properties may take 2-3 weeks. Weather delays are common during Illinois spring and fall - professional contractors build buffer days into the schedule.
